notice: Published source claims are not founder approvals or current account entitlements.

facts.access_note: Program is free to join; cloud credits are subject to member qualification and terms.

facts.activation_trap: Free AWS account plans are not eligible; account must be upgraded to a Paid Tier Plan. Usage beyond credits or on ineligible services is billed.
facts.eligibility_published: Pre-series B; founded in the last 10 years; AWS account on Paid Tier Plan; new to Activate Credits or requesting more than previously received.
facts.expiry_note: Credits have expiration dates shown in the AWS Billing console; unredeemed promotional credit is forfeited after expiry.
facts.max_credit_condition: Starts with $1,000; select participants may qualify for additional credits up to $5,000.
facts.target_applicant: Self-funded or bootstrapped startups (no Activate Provider Org ID needed).

facts.acceptance: At the discretion of Google Cloud
facts.activation_trap: Credits apply to Google Cloud Platform services and select offerings only; third-party models are billed directly and not covered. Offer subject to change without notification.
facts.additional_benefit: $200 Google Skills credits; Google Workspace Business Plus free for 12 months for new signups (domain conditions apply).
facts.eligibility_published: Technology startup planning to seek venture funding soon; founded within the last 24 months; not yet received Google Cloud credits beyond the free trial; working MVP and defined product roadmap.
facts.exclusions_published: Not accepted: IPO'd or acquired companies, educational institutions, government entities, nonprofits, personal blogs or content, dev shops, consultancies, agencies, crypto mining.
facts.program: Google for Startups Cloud Program - Start tier
